"""Tests for compute_freshness_score in the learning-record adapter."""

import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from subject import compute_freshness_score


def test_record_created_now_scores_exactly_one():
    moment = datetime(2026, 3, 15, 9, 26, 31)
    assert compute_freshness_score(moment, moment) == 1.0


def test_one_day_old_matches_exponential_decay():
    created = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    now = created + timedelta(days=1)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.015), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_one_week_old_matches_exponential_decay():
    created = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, 0)
    now = created + timedelta(days=7)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.105), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_four_weeks_old_matches_exponential_decay():
    created = datetime(2025, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59)
    now = created + timedelta(days=28)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.42), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_eight_weeks_old_matches_exponential_decay():
    created = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 6, 30, 0)
    now = created + timedelta(days=56)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.84), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_fractional_day_age_uses_fractional_days():
    created = datetime(2026, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0)
    now = created + timedelta(hours=6)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.00375), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_non_integral_day_age_uses_exact_seconds():
    created = datetime(2026, 5, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    now = created + timedelta(days=1, hours=6)
    assert math.isclose(
        compute_freshness_score(created, now), math.exp(-0.01875), rel_tol=1e-9
    )


def test_future_created_at_is_clamped_to_full_freshness():
    now = datetime(2026, 7, 1, 8, 0, 0)
    created = now + timedelta(days=3)
    assert compute_freshness_score(created, now) == 1.0


def test_score_strictly_decreases_with_age():
    created = datetime(2026, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    scores = [
        compute_freshness_score(created, created + timedelta(days=d))
        for d in (0, 1, 7, 28, 56, 365)
    ]
    assert all(later < earlier for earlier, later in zip(scores, scores[1:]))


def test_score_stays_positive_and_bounded_for_very_old_records():
    created = datetime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    days = (now - created).days
    score = compute_freshness_score(created, now)
    assert 0.0 < score <= 1.0
    assert math.isclose(score, math.exp(-0.015 * days), rel_tol=1e-9)
